title: Noophorics: a quantitative science of transferring understanding across heterogeneous minds
description:
An open research programme measuring the transfer of understanding between systems with non-identical priors. It replaces symbol recovery with behavioural convergence toward a declared reference over a declared probe measure, which yields measurable quantities: transfer fidelity, noophoric efficiency, channel capacity, phantom agreement (the gap between the parties' confidence that understanding occurred and the evidence that it did), and the calibration slope.

The repository contains the axiomatic foundation, six falsifiable conjectural laws, twelve open problems, a dependency-free reference implementation, pre-registered experiments with their raw draws, and a public record of every claim the programme has withdrawn.
